analyst.summary: ACC delivered record cement volumes in Q4 FY26 but a 68% YoY profit decline on cost pass-through lag, against a balance sheet that remains almost debt-free; the stock is also mid-process on its board-approved amalgamation into parent Ambuja Cements (100:328 swap, appointed date 1-Jan-2026, NCLT process pending, completion targeted FY27), so its low trailing multiple reflects merger-arb overhang and a depressed earnings base as much as any standalone value opportunity.
